title: Grateful Dead Live at P.N.E. Garden Auditorium on 1966-07-30

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear 1966 soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by a smoking Cream Puff War and a fierce Viola Lee Blues.
ai_review.review: The upgraded soundboard mix is praised as remarkably clear for a recording made over fifty years ago, delivering an excellent listening experience. Musically the performance is described as “smokin” with Phil’s bass taking center stage and Cream Puff War serving as a standout set‑closer, while the overall energy of the concert is rated very high.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (7 out of 9) give 4‑5 stars, highlighting superb sound quality and strong performances; only one strongly negative review drags the average down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly call the mix crystal‑clear, well‑balanced and polished for a 1966 source; no significant dropouts or muddiness mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight, energetic set that builds on the previous night’s material, with strong transitions and a memorable closing featuring Cream Puff War.

band_member_comments.Phil: Multiple reviewers note a "Phil bomb" – powerful bass work and an impressive intro.
